The pipeline will remove the source matte, resize the raster, and apply the fixed backing role mask. No frame, rim, ornament, emblem, skill icon, rarity cue, medallion, letter, number, word, label, scenery, glow, colored magic, or bright focal mark. Output only this isolated provider-source raster.
